scope: Official Qwen3-ASR streaming implementation long-session audio accumulation/reprocessing risk and the exact discriminator required before Frankenstein streaming promotion.
finding: The current official streaming implementation appends each chunk to an ever-growing audio buffer and re-feeds all audio seen so far at every decode step. Upstream long-session degradation reports therefore become a mandatory target-runtime falsifier, not a proven Frankenstein runtime failure.
coordination_note: Reuse the existing T7-ASR-004 target executor/handoff. This claim adds a source falsifier and benchmark dimension only; it does not schedule a second model execution lane.
